featureCards.title: Persona-driven chat
featureCards.description: Start each conversation with a specialist persona instead of forcing one generic assistant to do every job.

featureCards.title: Media-capable workflows
featureCards.description: Move from text into image and audio tasks when the persona and plan support the next step.

featureCards.title: Real-time response flow
featureCards.description: Built for fast back-and-forth conversations so planning, writing, and iteration feel immediate.

howItWorksSteps.title: Pick the right persona
howItWorksSteps.description: Choose the Strategist for planning, the Teacher for explanation, the Creator for ideas, or any other approved persona.

howItWorksSteps.title: Give Droplet the job to do
howItWorksSteps.description: Send a prompt, add context, and keep the thread focused on one goal instead of starting from scratch every time.

howItWorksSteps.title: Turn the answer into output
howItWorksSteps.description: Use the result as a draft, a plan, a teaching aid, or the next step in a media workflow.
